source_binding.mechanism: selection/holdout separation applied to checker-mutation calibration

public_sources.claim_used: Evaluating and tuning on the same data overfits; a held-out test set should remain outside model selection, and repeatedly tuning to the test set leaks test information into selection.
Diversity-aware mutation adequacy was evaluated against unseen faults and is intended to capture richer fault-detection diversity than a one-dimensional mutation count.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No scikit-learn execution, external test runner, hosted compute, cloud service, or external model is required. Holdout semantics are reduced to a finite predeclared role-local matrix evaluated directly in Chat.

scope_limit: Constructed three-mutant holdout only. A single finite holdout does not establish arbitrary unseen-fault generalization, and repeated adaptation to the same holdout would eventually leak evaluation information.
unresolved_child: Repeated rounds can overfit a fixed holdout. A later leaf should test rolling/time-separated holdouts or evidence expiry so prior holdout outcomes cannot become permanent tuning targets.
